text: Final project of the postgraduate programme Exhibitions: Curating, design and space, starting from the premise: an imaginary exhibition. The proposal emerges from researching the internet aesthetic Liminal Space, which gathers images that are familiar yet strange (like an empty shopping mall or a school corridor at three in the morning), as well as the collective fiction and open-source archive of The Backrooms.
Building on this premise, an exhibition is proposed at the CCCB that translates and replicates the features of this peculiar urban legend that has millions of internet users obsessed.
As part of the research on the Backrooms.
